note: Paths are relative to the repository. This catalog describes the owner's dataset plan, not files bundled with a clone. Display decisions live in manifests/rights.json.

datasets.use: 2023 selected-player tracking and released coverage labels; training and evaluation
datasets.public_use: Owner-approved compact 2023 play exports and aggregate results
datasets.limits: No pre-snap frames, ball, linemen or rushers; defender selection uses knowledge of the play

datasets.use: 143 previously unseen 2024 input plays matched to Analytics labels already held locally
datasets.limits: The archive has no coverage labels; output files contain future coordinates and are not coverage-model inputs

datasets.use: Schedules, results and play-by-play; historical features and pregame forecasts
datasets.public_use: Derived game features, probabilities and results
datasets.limits: A current historical download is not evidence of when each upstream row was first published

datasets.use: 40 NFL broadcasts' released features and editorial annotations; ranking benchmark
datasets.public_use: Derived scores, curves, labels, timestamps, links and permitted short excerpts
datasets.limits: No footage redistribution; released feature extractors cannot yet be verified for new video

datasets.use: Local field-calibration research on labelled helmets and tracking
datasets.limits: 60 plays; no coverage labels; labelled helmets are not detector outputs

datasets.use: Owner-authorized local smoke tests of clips and speech transcription
datasets.limits: Permission to process locally is not permission to publish

rules: Private locations stay ignored by Git
Version derived artifacts by module and experiment
Frozen split manifests and reports/v1 are not overwritten
Review every export against manifests/rights.json before publishing
